newsitem.title: USA: American Energy files stock manipulation lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: American Energy files stock manipulation lawsuit.

text.p: American Energy Group Ltd said Thursday it has filed a lawsuit charging certain individuals and companies with conspiring to manipulate its stock.
The company said it filed the lawsuit in the U.S. District Court in Houston on July 30.
The company did not identify the defendants in a news release disclosing the lawsuit and the company's lawyer was not immediately avaiable to comment.

It said it is seeking an injunction to bar trading in the shares which it believes were "fraudulently obtained prior to the formation" of the company in 1994, until the court rules on their authenticity.
It estimated that between 1.5 million and 2.5 million shares could be affected by the outcome of the litigation. It does not expect litigation costs will adversely affect its operations, it said.

Bradley Simmons, president of the company, said that while the outcome of any litigation carries uncertainty, "management is optimistic that the lawsuit will result in additional market protection for the existing shareholders."
American Energy is a development stage independent oil and gas exploration, drilling, and production company involved with both domestic and international exploration projects.
